description: server/8.0/eventing/eventing-memory-quota.md was selected as one of two pages judged to have 'no Capella twin' on the premise that Capella manages Eventing memory automatically. cloud/eventing/eventing-faq.md contradicts that premise directly: it states a user-configurable 256MB memory-quota knob in Cluster Settings, in wording near-identical to the Server page's own description. Either the automatic-management premise is wrong and Capella exposes the same manual knob under a different page, or Capella's FAQ carries stale un-adapted Server language describing a control Capella customers cannot actually reach. No page resolves which, and this round's own dispatch briefing repeated the premise without checking it first.
